newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy Group signs letter of intent.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy Group signs letter of intent.

text.p: Key Energy Group Inc said it has tentatively agreed to acquire two well service companies for undisclosed terms.
It said the assets to be acquired include 20 well service rigs, fishing tools, trucks and ancillary services located in West Texas and Oklahoma.

One of the firms operates 16 well service units and conducts a complete fishing tool operation. The other operates five service units and conducts a small truck operation and a fishing tool operation.
The company noted it will increase its number of rigs from 325 to 345.
The acquisitions are contingent upon entering into definitive agreements, due diligence and receipt of board approvals. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
